purpose: Exploratory development diagnosis of plain versus game-framed candidate selection, answer order, WAIT labels, and synthetic protocol comprehension.

selection.source: Exact 40 diagnostic question IDs in the completed WAIT pilot

main_factorial.rotation_rule: Candidate content rotates cyclically through A-D; map predictions to canonical identities before comparison.

label_swap.interpretation: Targeted A/E action-label relabeling with candidate content order unchanged; not complete action-label permutation invariance.

comprehension.failed_model_decisions: Scientific findings, not a reason to discard data or change prompts mid-run.

reuse.rule: Require exact prompt, scored tokens, output boundary, model files, precision and runtime identities; preserve original rows and join through an explicit identity map.

analysis.unit: question; retain all menus, rotations, rounds and arms together
main_comparisons: semantic agreement across four candidate rotations
primary versus A/E relabeling actions and episodic rewards
references: fixed answer round using each prompt own candidates
hindsight best same-prompt candidate or PASS; unavailable to deployable policies
analysis.comprehension: Exact expected semantic action derived from explicitly supplied certainty and payoff premises; report all cases, not a significance test.
analysis.calibration: Optional original-pilot calibration-only fit; selection outputs remain descriptive because both sets have already been inspected.
analysis.multiplicity: Exploratory intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims.

budget.throughput_gate: Forecast all remaining production and diagnostic work with conservative batch timing; stop before production if it cannot fit the worker deadline and total reservation
budget.budget_stop: Preserve partial evidence, never retry or change precision automatically; any smaller sample requires a newly frozen design before pilot outcomes are inspected
budget.scope: New two-worker run only. Reservation is not an invoice or an account-wide billing limit.

interpretation_limits: 40 independent development questions; more contexts do not increase that sample size.
Single-token deterministic action scoring, not generated response frequencies.
Plain versus game changes the instruction block; it does not isolate each sentence or reward component.
Four cyclic rotations balance candidate positions but do not exhaust all 24 candidate orders.
A/E relabeling is a targeted control; it changes both action and displaced-candidate labels.
Word-fraction prefixes are retained to isolate prompt effects; clue-boundary evaluation is a subsequent protocol change.
No confirmatory test questions, broad model ranking, IRT ability, or optimal stopping claim.
